title: kbmon's cost line says it counts only kb-logged usage rows, not the day's total spend
goal: kbmon's cost line is headed `Logged cost today` and keeps the rows' count (`Logged cost today: $4.40 over 4 usage rows, 10.9M tokens`), in the cost and all answers; the cost answer names what it sums (the usage rows and sidecars the query log holds) and says it is `not the day's total`

run:
import atexit,shutil,tempfile
_m=tempfile.mkdtemp
def _d(*a,**k):
 d=_m(*a,**k);atexit.register(shutil.rmtree,d,True);return d
tempfile.mkdtemp=_d
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import mon_status
usage = {"rows": 4, "tokens": 10_900_000, "usd": 4.4, "unpriced": [], "by_model": {}, "by_session": {}, "by_sprint": {}, "by_topic": {}}
snap = {"taken": "2026-11-08T12:00:00Z", "panels": {"querylog": {"state": "ok", "data": {"usage_today": usage, "spool": {}}}}}
text = "\n".join(mon_status.answer(snap, "cost")["lines"])
every = "\n".join(mon_status.answer({**snap, "panels": {n: {"state": "ok", "data": {"usage_today": usage, "spool": {}, "sprints": [], "claims": [], "procs": []}} for n in ("querylog", "sprint", "coord", "sessions", "host")}}, "all")["lines"])
print(text, every, sep="\n")
bad = (not text.startswith("Logged cost today: $4.40 over 4 usage rows, 10.9M tokens") or "Cost today" in text or "Cost today" in every
       or "Logged cost today: $4.40 over 4 usage rows" not in every or "sidecars" not in text or "not the day's total" not in text)
sys.exit(not not bad)
